name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | NROL-179
description: Fourteenth batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1103 has landed on Landing Zone 4 after its 3rd flight.
